message: Hi, I opened my account last week and sent payment links to 3 clients. They all paid by card (one of them sent me a screenshot, card 4242 4242 4242 4242, charged 220 eur) but in my app it all says pending and I cant withdraw anything. Is something wrong?
key_facts: Payments of a Payment Request paid by card appear at once as pending
For the first 3 Payment Requests paid by card of a new account the money is available after 7 calendar days
Normally the money is available after 3 business days
Three card payments (TX-000025, TX-000026, TX-000027) are pending on the account

history.text: my 1200 euro withdrawal to my greek bank failed, app shows ERR-2003. what does that mean?
ERR-2003 means the receiving bank rejected the withdrawal. The money goes back to your balance in 3-7 business days. Please check the bank details with your bank and create the withdrawal again.
thanks, i checked with the bank, details were fine, i will try again later

key_facts: The withdrawal TX-000142 of 1200.00 EUR was rejected by the beneficiary bank (ERR-2003) and has the status returned
A failed or returned withdrawal costs nothing: the withdrawal fee is not charged

message: wtf my withdrawl of 900e keeps failng!! app says ERR-2010 or smth. i copy pasted the iban from an old email of mine, its my own bank so whats the problem
key_facts: ERR-2010 means the IBAN is not valid
Copy the IBAN exactly from the bank or the bank's app and check every character, including the country code
Enter the IBAN again and create the withdrawal again
The failed withdrawal TX-000161 costs nothing: the withdrawal fee is not charged

message: Card declined yesterday evening at CoinHarbor, 500 usd. I have 1840 usd in my balance so it cant be the money. The card works fine everywhere else. Please fix.
key_facts: The 500.00 USD card payment was declined with ERR-3005: merchant category blocked
The card cannot be used for gambling, crypto exchanges or adult content
Use another way to pay this merchant

message: Good morning. Our company card payment at Tidewater Hotel (EUR 1,450) was refused yesterday with ERR-3011, although the account has plenty of money. Our travel manager is stuck at the desk. Can you tell us why this happened and when it works again?
key_facts: ERR-3011 means the daily card spend limit was reached; the limit is €15,000 per day for Business
Pending card payments count toward the daily card spend limit
The same day, two earlier card payments of 8,950.00 EUR and 4,880.00 EUR (TX-000124, TX-000125) were still pending
Daily limits reset at 00:00 CET
Try again after the limit resets

message: i uploaded my passport for verification and its rejected. app says ERR-4002. what do i do now and how long till its checked again
key_facts: ERR-4002 means the document has expired
Upload a document that is still valid
After the new upload the Compliance team reviews it; KYC takes 1-2 business days

Hello, a payment of 250 eur from Brightwave Studio was refused yesterday with ERR-1020 and I dont understand why, I have only 905 in my account. What is my monthly receive limit and what do I need to raise it? I tried to upgrade my account before but it got rejected.
key_facts: ERR-1020 means the monthly receive limit of the tier was reached; the Starter limit is €1,000 per month
This month the account received 600.00 EUR and 360.00 EUR (TX-000044, TX-000045), so the payment of 250.00 EUR (TX-000046) went over the limit
The monthly limit resets on the 1st day of the month
A Starter account cannot ask for a limit increase; to get higher limits it must move to the Verified tier through verification
The Verified tier has a receive limit of €30,000 per month and needs proof of address and proof of source of income
The upgrade was rejected with ERR-4010: the proof of address is older than 3 months; upload a utility bill or bank statement not older than 3 months

message: WHY is my account blocked??? my 4000 withdrawal failed yesterday and then my card was declined at the supermarket. I have rent to pay!! tell me the reason right now, I did nothing wrong
key_facts: ERR-5010 means the account is under review
The team may contact you and ask for documents; upload them as soon as you can
A review typically takes up to 10 business days

message: I just opened the app and there are 2 payments from the night before last that are NOT mine, 230 at QuickCart and 80 at some fuel station. I was asleep. Someone has my card or my account. Please do something!!
key_facts: Freeze the card in the app now
Unauthorised transactions must be reported within 13 months
A person from the team handles the case

message: Orchard Office Supplies charged my card twice for one order, 189 eur each, one minute apart. I only ordered once. How do I get one of them back?
key_facts: Two card payments of 189.00 EUR to Orchard Office Supplies (TX-000021, TX-000022) are on the account
A card payment can be disputed within 120 days from the transaction date
To ask for a dispute, contact us with the date, the amount and the merchant name, explain what went wrong and add proof
A person from the team checks the request before the dispute is opened
A dispute decision takes up to 45 days; complex cases up to 90 days

message: My new physical card never arrived. I ordered it more than a month ago, standard delivery, I live in France. Nothing in the mailbox.
key_facts: Standard delivery takes 7-14 business days in the EU
If the time has passed, contact us with the date of the order and the delivery country
A virtual card is free and can be used while waiting

message: I want to close my account. Also why did you take 5 euro from me twice? I dont even use this account anymore
key_facts: The balance must be zero before closing; withdraw all money first, otherwise the app shows ERR-5012
A withdrawal costs €1.50 by SEPA (EUR to a bank in the EU) and €15 by SWIFT (everything else); closing the account is free
The account is closed 30 days after the request
The inactivity fee is €5 per month after 12 months without transactions and never takes the balance below zero
Using the account once in 12 months avoids the fee
